tool_usage_rules: system sleep and recovery management only
no unilateral sleep initiation — requires WOLFIE directive
all sleep/wake cycles must be logged with BIGINT UTC timestamps
recovery procedures must restore state to last known good checkpoint
tool_constraints: no hard system kills without documented escalation
no schema modification during sleep cycles
wake-on-demand must be deterministic and reversible
activation_rules: activate on WOLFIE maintenance window directive
